text: {"name":"ke_timer_tick_inc","confidence":"high","docstring":"Advances the kernel timer counter, clamps a 16-bit field in each of twelve timer records to 1, and performs threshold-dependent HCI/MAC processing.","subsystem":"ke","var_renames":{"v0":"timer_state_base","v1":"next_tick","v2":"timer_record_cursor"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"16-bit per-record field clamped to 1 when its value exceeds 1"},{"offset":6480,"meaning":"32-bit timer tick counter, incremented and reset to -1 at the threshold"},{"offset":6484,"meaning":"32-bit tick threshold compared with the incremented counter"}]}
